title: MLINESTYLE APPID and ordered XDATA profile

scope.source: Runtime-generated MLINESTYLE authority recipe; no external fixture is used.
scope.cross_product: Both source encodings were exported to both output encodings.
scope.edit: MLINESTYLE description changed to 'edited MLINE XDATA profile'.

proof.source: Physical source groups and fresh reader show one APPID table provider and the exact ordered MLINESTYLE XDATA pair.
proof.output: Physical output groups show one APPID provider and the exact ordered MLINESTYLE XDATA pair; fresh libdxfrw readback verifies provider, typed values, and edited description.
proof.failure_retry: A 32-byte group-1001 APPID value is refused for each output encoding, preserves the pre-existing destination sentinel and caller state, then succeeds after restoring the valid APPID on the same adapter.

limits: This qualifies selected AC1027 XDATA transport for one MLINESTYLE host and one APPID provider profile; it is not independent native semantic evidence.
Other XDATA groups, ordering, APPID identity/collision cases, consumer schemas, versions, proxy/unknown subclasses, native rendering, and composed document closure remain open.
